author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-10-19 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: Then they analyzed it and discovered it to be dead.
context_before: “In many and various ways God spoke of old to our fathers by the prophets, but in these last days he has spoken to us by his Son,” for when the Son appears he reveals God as his Father. Until God’s son reveals himself in Man, Man searches on the outside to discover how things are made, but he cannot find the Maker. Our world is God’s handiwork, as told us in the 19th Psalm: “The heavens declare the glory of God and the firmament shows forth his handiwork.” Our scientists have discovered how to go to the moon, from which they returned with earth.
context_after: No matter where man goes he will discover that everything is dead, for God’s handiwork is here and here alone. But, no matter how much his handiwork is analyzed, it will not reveal its maker.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from I Am The Cause (1969-10-19).

author: Neville Goddard

quote_original: But one day you will awaken!
context_before: The first name given to you when you fell asleep was �El Shaddai� which means �God Almighty, or Mighty God�.
context_after: Now completely individualized, you will feel a vibration so great you will think you are going to die; but far from dying, the vibration will awaken you from your long, long sleep. You will awaken within yourself to discover that you have been entombed there for unnumbered centuries. You may not know how you got there and why, but I’ll tell you: you went voluntarily. No one took your life, you laid it down yourself.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from I Am The Cause (1969-10-19).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-10-19 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
context_before: It takes an enormous power for Mighty God to stir himself and awaken to find the symbol of his birth as that of a child. You may think the child that is born and the son which is given are one and the same, but they are not.
context_after: It is he who reveals you as God, the Maker and creator of it all. Prior to that moment in time you – like a scientist – look outside of yourself for the cause of all life; but when David – God’s only begotten son – comes from within and calls you Father, you have found the cause. And when your son reveals you as the Father, the cause of all life, you will bear the name Everlasting Father.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from I Am The Cause (1969-10-19).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-10-19 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: And in scripture the Wonderful Counselor is associated with a serpent.
context_before: Now, the third great revelation is that of Wonderful Counselor.
context_after: Referred to as the wisest of all of God’s creations, it was the serpent who suggested eating of the tree of knowledge. And when told he would die, the serpent said; “No, you will not truly die. For God knows that when you eat of it your eyes will be opened and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.” The Wonderful Counselor did not lie, for believing himself to be you, he experienced death but did not really die.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from I Am The Cause (1969-10-19).

author: Neville Goddard

context_before: Your eyes will be opened then, and you will know good and evil from experience. You will know that you will not die, but will return to the heavenly state from which you – the son of man – descended.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-10-19 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: So don’t look for any change on the outside.
context_before: The ministers of this world are talking about His coming, trying to interpret signs on the outside. But I tell you, Jesus does not come at the end of human history, for he comes individually. Tonight one of you could experience his coming. No one knows but the Father in you. Ever since that Father fell asleep all things have continued as they were from the beginning of creation.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-10-19 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: This I know from personal experience.
context_before: The Bible is all about you, and you are here in the final picture to fulfill that which you dictated before you came down. The prophets you inspired were only organs of revelation. And God’s son, by his very nature reveals God as his father. So when God’s only begotten son stands before you and reveals you as his father, are you not God the Father?
context_after: I am not speculating. I am not theorizing. I did not hear it from a man, nor was I taught it.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from I Am The Cause (1969-10-19).

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1969-10-19 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: That is all I am here to tell you.
context_before: Scripture is based upon the principle that the True Man comes here to fulfill. All that is said about the True you in the law of Moses and the prophets and the psalms, must and will be fulfilled. It is my pleasure and my privilege to open your mind that you may understand scripture.
context_after: But you will never really understand my words until you experience them, and you will.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from I Am The Cause (1969-10-19).
